title: Killers
description: This Is A Manhunt Modpack... It Has A Ton Of Structures, Create Mod, Guns,Create Aeronautics, More
body:
Step into a world where engineering, firepower, and survival collide. Killers is a Create-based modpack built for chaos, creativity, and high-stakes gameplay.

Harness the full potential of the Create mod and its many addons to construct massive factories, automated systems, and complex machines. Take innovation to the skies with aeronautics, building airships and flying contraptions to explore, escape, or hunt from above.

With a wide arsenal of guns and combat-focused mechanics, Killers is designed primarily for intense Manhunt-style gameplay. Track your targets, outsmart your hunters, and use both engineering and combat skills to survive. Whether you're setting traps, launching aerial pursuits, or gearing up for direct combat, every moment counts.

Powered by the Essentials mod, multiplayer is quick and seamless—perfect for playing with friends. Prefer to play alone? You can still enjoy the full experience by building, exploring, and surviving at your own pace.

Features:

Expanded Create mod experience with tons of addons
Guns and combat systems for fast-paced action
Aeronautics and airships for vertical gameplay
Designed for Manhunt, but fully playable solo
Easy multiplayer with Essentials
